about.description: Olha que Duas is a Portuguese online radio that combines entertainment, wellness, and authentic conversations. With diverse programming ranging from nutrition and motivation to relaxed debates, we are on air 24 hours a day to keep you company.
about.appTagline: Official Olha que Duas Radio app

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.batteryDesc: To keep the radio playing in the background without interruptions, disable battery optimization for this app.
troubleshooting.brandDesc: Some manufacturers restrict background apps. Follow the instructions for your brand:
troubleshooting.xiaomiSteps: Settings → Battery → Olha que Duas → No restrictions. Also: Apps → Olha que Duas → Autostart → Enabled.
troubleshooting.samsungSteps: Settings → Device care → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → Add app.
troubleshooting.huaweiSteps: Settings → Battery → App launch → Olha que Duas → Manage manually → Allow all.
troubleshooting.oppoSteps: Settings → Battery → More settings → Optimize battery use → Olha que Duas → Don't optimize.
troubleshooting.otherSteps: Settings → Battery → Olha que Duas → Unrestricted. If not found, search for 'battery optimization' in settings.
troubleshooting.lockAppDesc: In the recent apps screen, long-press the Olha que Duas card and tap the lock icon. This prevents the system from closing the app.
